text: 瑞银中国股票策略研究主管王宗豪指出，瑞银对约800只外资主动型基金的跟踪显示，三季度外资机构投资者的中国股票仓位总体保持不变。分行业看，国际投资者增持最多的是医疗保健、互联网和科技板块（可能来自IPO和配售），同时减持了保险、基础材料和汽车板块。鉴于风险回报具有吸引力，瑞银仍看好中国AI科技硬件，但近期全球科技股大跌可能对中国国内相关个股产生进一步连锁影响。鉴于AI的市场情绪仍较脆弱，且公募基金的AI科技硬件持仓仍处于高位，他建议采用科技硬件与银行相结合的杠铃策略。
text_en: Wang Zonghao, head of China equity strategy research at UBS, noted that UBS's tracking of about 800 foreign active funds shows foreign institutional investors' China equity positions were broadly unchanged in Q3. By sector, international investors increased holdings the most in healthcare, internet and tech (possibly from IPOs and placements), while cutting insurance, basic materials and autos. Given attractive risk-reward, UBS remains bullish on China AI tech hardware, but the recent global tech selloff may have further knock-on effects on related Chinese domestic stocks. Given fragile AI market sentiment and still-high AI tech hardware holdings among mutual funds, he recommends a barbell strategy combining tech hardware and banks.
